cases.shortcut: popular architecture pattern => justified architecture decision
authority_tokens: Patterns are options whose applicability must follow Product drivers, constraints and evidence.
A high-impact `UNKNOWN` MUST NOT silently become implementation freedom.
An implementation Agent may not select its preferred architecture pattern merely because the UNKNOWN was left unresolved.
File count, line count or estimated token count alone MUST NOT define Task boundaries
shared state invariant that only holds after both branches merge
Do not remove a dependency merely to make a Task appear READY
do not replace Task DAG dependencies

cases.shortcut: DAG mutation without durable reason/authority/impact => valid mutation
Agent-local tool version => repository profile authority
authority_tokens: Agent-local tooling is execution capability/evidence, never profile authority.
`tool installed -> project selected that tool` is forbidden.
A profile MUST NOT claim that its examples are universally required by every repository in that language/archetype.
Profiles cannot manufacture a new global requirement merely by labeling a tool/convention required.
`PROJECT_OVERRIDES` may select, specialize or strengthen applicable mappings, but MUST NOT silently weaken Frozen/Core authority.
Frozen/Core normative authority always remains authoritative.
